Fitz Hugh Ludlow, The Hashish Eater.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/fitz-hugh-ludlow/the-hashish-eater

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Fitz Hugh Ludlow, the author, died 1870 (Wikidata Q320460, P570 = 1870-09-12).

First publication of the text used: 1857 (SE colophon: 'The Hashish Eater was published in 1857 by Fitz Hugh Ludlow.'). Wikipedia (The Hasheesh Eater): first published in 1857 by Harper & Brothers, a New York publisher; the article names no UK edition.

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the edition states the text is in the United States public domain (statement quoted below), and the text was first published in the United States in 1857, before 1931.
- Country of origin (United States): the text was first published in the United States, before 1931, so the US rule settles the country of origin whatever the death year. Ludlow died in 1870, and that date does not change the result.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."

Sources of these facts:
- SE colophon: published 1857 by Fitz Hugh Ludlow.
- Wikipedia, The Hasheesh Eater: first published 1857 by Harper & Brothers. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Hasheesh_Eater
